welcomeMessage:
Welcome to Falcus Media Ltd! 👋

We are here to help you with social media services, monetization, account services, advertising and support.

To get started, we first need to identify the account/page you need help with.

options.title: New Facebook Page
formQuestions: If applicable, please send the link to the account or page you are contacting us about. (Reply 'N/A' if this is for a new account)
What name should we use to identify this account or business?
What email address can we use to contact you about this request?
What name would you like for the Facebook Page?
What type of business, brand, organization or personality is the page for?
Please describe what the page will be used for.
Do you already have a Facebook account that should own the page? Reply Yes or No.
Do you have a logo and other branding materials? Reply Yes or No.
options.onCompleteMessage: ✅ Your Facebook Page creation request has been received. We will review the information and proceed with the setup.

options.title: Criteria Facebook Page
formQuestions: If applicable, please send the link to the account or page you are contacting us about. (Reply 'N/A' if this is for a new account)

Please describe the type of Facebook Page you want us to create.
What niche or category should the page belong to?
What country or location should the page target?
What name should the page have?
Please provide any specific criteria or requirements you have for the page.
options.onCompleteMessage: ✅ Your Criteria Facebook Page request has been received. Our team will review your requirements and contact you if additional information is required.

Please provide any branding information you want us to use.

options.title: Other Problem
options.reply: Please describe your issue in as much detail as possible. Our support system will first try to identify the appropriate solution before transferring you to a human agent.

mainMenu.title: Talk to a Human
mainMenu.reply: I am transferring you to a Falcus Media Ltd support agent. Please hold on while we connect you with a human representative.

aiKnowledgeBase.purpose: Answer common customer questions, troubleshoot common problems, explain Falcus Media services and resolve customer requests automatically whenever possible.

generalFaq.answer: Falcus Media Ltd provides digital media and social media services, including social media management, page creation, monetization services, account services, advertising campaign setup, page optimization, followers services, watch time services and other digital media solutions.

questionPatterns: I want to talk to someone
Can I speak to a human?
generalFaq.answer: Absolutely. I can first collect the important details about your request so you do not have to repeat yourself when the human agent joins. If you prefer, I can transfer you to a human agent now.

questionPatterns: What account should I pay to?
generalFaq.answer: Payment details depend on the service you selected. I will provide the official Falcus Media Ltd payment details when payment is required for your selected service. After payment, please send your proof of payment here.

questionPatterns: My payment has not been confirmed
generalFaq.answer: No problem. Please send your proof of payment and your order/reference number if you have one. We will use the information to verify the transaction.
I'm sorry about the delay. Let me check the details of your request. Please provide your order/reference number if you have one, or send the account/page link associated with the request.

questionPatterns: What is the status of my request?
What is happening with my order?
generalFaq.answer: I can help you check your request. Please provide your order/reference number. If you do not have one, provide the account or page link associated with the request.

commonQuestions: Can you create a Facebook Page for me?
What do you need to create my page?
How long does page creation take?
serviceFaq.answer: Yes. Falcus Media can assist with creating and setting up a new Facebook Page. We will collect the Page name, business/brand information, category, intended use and required branding information before processing the request.

commonQuestions: Can you create a specific type of Facebook Page?
I need a page with specific requirements
Can you create a page according to my criteria?
serviceFaq.answer: Yes. We can review your requirements and determine the appropriate Page setup. Please provide the niche, target location, preferred name and the specific criteria you require.

commonQuestions: Can you create a UK TikTok?
I need a UK TikTok account
Do you create UK TikTok accounts?
serviceFaq.answer: Yes. Falcus Media provides a UK TikTok account creation service. I will collect the purpose of the account, preferred username, niche and other requirements before submitting the request.

commonQuestions: Can you create a USA TikTok?
I need a US TikTok account
Do you create USA TikTok accounts?
serviceFaq.answer: Yes. Falcus Media provides a USA TikTok account creation service. I will collect the account purpose, preferred username, niche and other requirements before submitting your request.

commonQuestions: What is connected entity?
I need connected entity
Can you help with connected entity?
serviceFaq.answer: Falcus Media provides Connected Entity assistance. Please provide the relevant Page, Profile or Business link and explain what you want to achieve or the problem you are experiencing.

commonQuestions: Can you change my page name?
I want to change my Facebook Page name
How much is name change?
serviceFaq.answer: Yes. Falcus Media provides Facebook Page name change assistance. We will need your Page link, current name, desired new name and reason for the change.

commonQuestions: Do you provide watch time?
Can you help with YouTube watch hours?
I need YouTube watch time
serviceFaq.answer: Yes. Falcus Media provides a YouTube Watch Time Service. Please send your YouTube channel link and tell us your target watch hours and current channel status so we can review your request.

commonQuestions: Do you sell followers?
I need followers
Can you increase my followers?
How can I get more followers?
serviceFaq.answer: Falcus Media provides followers services for supported social media platforms. Please tell me the platform, send the account link and specify the number of followers you require.

commonQuestions: Do you run ads?
Can you set up Facebook ads?
Can you run an advertising campaign?
I need an ad campaign
serviceFaq.answer: Yes. Falcus Media can assist with advertising campaign setup. We will need your business/page link, product or service, advertising objective, target audience, location and intended advertising budget.

commonQuestions: Can you optimize my page?
My page needs improvement
Can you improve my Facebook Page?
What is page optimization?
serviceFaq.answer: Yes. Page optimization involves reviewing your social media presence and identifying areas that can be improved. Send your Page/Profile link and explain what you want to improve.

commonQuestions: Do you manage social media?
Can you manage my social media account?
I need monthly social media management
Do you provide social media management?
serviceFaq.answer: Yes. Falcus Media provides social media management services. We can review your platforms, business, content needs and goals and determine the appropriate management package.

commonQuestions: Can you monetize my page?
Can you monetize my profile?
I want to monetize my Facebook account
Why is my page not monetized?
serviceFaq.answer: Yes. Falcus Media provides Facebook Page and Profile monetization assistance. Please send the relevant account link and describe the current monetization status or problem.

commonQuestions: My Facebook profile is disabled
Can you recover my disabled account?
My account was disabled
serviceFaq.answer: Falcus Media provides assistance with disabled profile resolution. Please send the affected Profile link, tell us when it was disabled, provide the reason/message shown by Facebook and tell us whether you have already appealed.
serviceFaq.refundPolicy: 100% refund if unsuccessful, subject to Falcus Media Ltd service terms.

commonQuestions: My Facebook Page is suspended
Can you recover my suspended page?
My page has been suspended
serviceFaq.answer: Falcus Media provides assistance with suspended Facebook Pages. Please send the affected Page link, tell us when the suspension occurred, provide the reason shown by Facebook and tell us whether an appeal has already been submitted.
serviceFaq.refundPolicy: 100% refund if unsuccessful, subject to Falcus Media Ltd service terms.

commonQuestions: Can you verify my profile?
I want to verify my Facebook profile
How much is verification?
serviceFaq.answer: Falcus Media provides profile verification assistance. Please send the relevant profile link to begin.

paymentRules.paymentInstruction: Only provide official Falcus Media Ltd payment details when the selected service requires payment. Customers should send proof of payment after completing the transaction.

completionFlow.step1: Confirm all required information has been collected.
completionFlow.step2: If payment is required, confirm that payment evidence has been submitted.
completionFlow.step3: Create or update the customer's service request.
completionFlow.step4: Provide the customer with a reference number where supported.

aiSupportRules.objective: Resolve approximately 70-90% of common customer requests without human intervention while escalating complex, sensitive or unresolved issues to a human agent.
beforeEscalation: Check whether the problem matches a known solution.
Provide the appropriate troubleshooting or information.
Ask the customer whether the solution resolved the problem.
Only escalate if the problem remains unresolved or requires human authorization.
escalateWhen: The customer explicitly requests a human agent.
The issue requires manual account access or internal action.
The customer reports a payment dispute that cannot be automatically verified.
The AI cannot confidently determine the correct solution.
The customer has attempted the recommended solution and it did not work.
The request involves sensitive account recovery requiring manual review.
The request falls outside the available Falcus Media services.
aiSupportRules.escalationMessage: I have collected the important information about your request so you do not need to explain everything again. I am now transferring your case to a human agent.

chatFlowUpdate.purpose: Upgrade Falcus Media Ltd chatbot from a basic keyword/form chatbot into an intent-based AI customer service system.

globalRules.coreInstruction: Always understand what the customer is trying to accomplish before deciding how to respond. Never require the customer to use the exact service name or exact wording used in the system.
globalRules.importantRule: If the customer's message can reasonably be mapped to an existing service, support category, FAQ, payment request, order request or human-support request, route the customer to the appropriate flow instead of using the fallback response.

security.securityMessage: For your security, please do not send passwords, OTPs, 2FA codes, PINs or other security credentials in this chat.

intentRouter.instruction: Analyze every incoming customer message and determine the customer's intent before generating a response. Match meaning rather than exact words.

paymentFlow.instruction: Recognize payment-related questions even when the customer does not mention the name of the service.

steps.instruction: Check whether the customer has already selected a service in the current conversation.

knowledgeBaseRouting.instruction: If the message is a question rather than a service request, search the AI knowledge base before using fallback.

fallback.importantRule: Fallback must only be used when the AI cannot reasonably determine the customer's intent after checking intent routing, conversation context and the knowledge base.
neverSay: I received your message, but I'm not entirely sure how to answer that based on my current training.
I don't know how to answer that.
fallback.firstFallback: I want to make sure I direct you to the right place. Are you looking for a service, payment help, order support, or help with an existing account?
fallback.secondFallback: Please describe what you need help with in a little more detail. You can also type 'human' if you would like to speak with a support agent.

afterMaxAttempts.message: I don't want to give you the wrong information. I have collected the information available and will transfer your request to a human support agent.

rules: Never respond with a generic fallback when an existing service matches the customer's intent.
Understand natural variations of service requests.
If the customer says 'I want followers', open the Followers Service.
If the customer says 'I want to buy followers', open the Followers Service.
If the customer says 'Where do I pay?', detect Payment Intent.
If the customer says 'I paid', detect Payment Status Intent.
If the customer previously selected a service and then asks about payment, use that service context.
Do not ask for information already provided.
Do not send customers back to the main menu unnecessarily.
Ask only questions relevant to the current service.
Keep responses short, natural and conversational.
Do not mention internal AI systems, training, intent detection or knowledge bases to customers.

triggerWhen: AI cannot determine intent after two attempts.
Customer has tried the available troubleshooting steps and the problem remains unresolved.
Customer requests something outside Falcus Media services.
humanEscalation.handoffMessage: I've collected the important information about your request, so you won't need to repeat everything. I'm transferring your case to a Falcus Media support agent now.

developerImplementationRules.instruction: The application must perform intent detection and routing before triggering the generic fallback response.
processingOrder: Search knowledge base if the message is informational.
Only use fallback if no reasonable intent can be determined.
